label: Resize column
intent: The column boundary is dragged to a new width. Light: the resize handle (the double arrow under the boundary) pulls right, the boundary follows a beat later and stops dead at the wider column, then both ease home. Strong: a grab-tug left, a long drag right that stops dead, a smaller correction back past rest to the left that also clicks, then home. The frame never resizes.

frame.//: v1 Solid is the frame ring plus the divider at 2.6, with both columns open
